title: When God plants something in you, no storm has the authority to uproot it.
paragraphs:
When God plants something in you, no storm has the authority to uproot it.
Winds may rise. Clouds may darken. But His promises stay rooted deeper than any battle you face.
Stand firm—your breakthrough is already growing beneath the surface. 🌱✨

“Every plant that My heavenly Father has planted will never be uprooted.”
— Matthew 15:13
